# Korea Economic Narrative Intelligence

This site publishes a read-only, machine-readable projection of economic and industrial narrative data derived from the print editions of Maeil Business Newspaper and Korea Economic Daily.

Coverage:
- Publishers: 매일경제, 한국경제
- Print scope: A1-A10
- Collection period: 2026-06-01 ~ 2026-09-26
- Full article text is not stored or redistributed.
- Article summaries are independently rewritten factual summaries.
- Theme/Candidate counts describe observed media coverage; they are not investment scores or importance rankings.

Primary resources:
- Latest text: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoundongKim/newspaper-ai-public/main/ai/latest.txt
- Latest compact JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoundongKim/newspaper-ai-public/main/ai/latest.json
- Themes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoundongKim/newspaper-ai-public/main/ai/themes.json
- Emerging Candidate signals: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoundongKim/newspaper-ai-public/main/ai/candidates.json
- Narrative changes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoundongKim/newspaper-ai-public/main/ai/narrative.json
- All verified article metadata and factual summaries in the collection period: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YoundongKim/newspaper-ai-public/main/ai/articles.json
- Interactive dashboard: private / authentication required
